note: The Zen icon vocabulary and where each mark is implemented. Two production representations of one design vocabulary, deliberately NOT one shared source file: the two runtimes are different (static sanitized SVG here, procedural brush geometry in the dashboard) and coupling them would buy drift protection at the cost of an architectural dependency neither repo needs.

provenance.origin: Original Figma handoff — 149 raw SVG exports, formerly at design/zen-icons-source/.
provenance.inventory: 149 files, 324904 bytes. Per-file sha256 in design/zen-source-manifest.json.
provenance.status: Removed from the working tree 2026-09-16. It was imported by nothing — no runtime, build, config, CI or test reference — and its presence invited the reading that 149 obsolete exports were canonical. Git preserves the originals; provenance does not require them in the tree.
provenance.authority: The PRODUCTION implementations below are authoritative. The Figma export is their historical ancestor, not their master.

docs.form: sanitized static SVG, viewBox 0 0 100 100, fill=currentColor, inlined into the pages
docs.measuredFloor: ~18px. Measured 2026-09-16: at 16px five of six shipped marks fall below 0.75 peak alpha; at 20px all clear. Every shipped Zen control renders at 16-17.6px WITH the 1.15x bump, i.e. ~18-20px effective, so none is impaired.

dashboard.form: procedural brush geometry on a 100-unit box, generated at runtime through a turbulence + displacement filter
dashboard.measuredFloor: 24px. A DIFFERENT number from the docs floor for a different reason: what fails below 24 there is the filter's taper and grain, not coverage. Same visual family, independently measured runtime constraints — neither floor transfers to the other repo.

marks.usage: copy a link to this part
